title: Checkout
loginRequired: Please sign in or create a customer account to complete your order.

contact.title: Your details
contact.emailHint: Your confirmation and tickets are sent to this address.
contact.phoneHint: Please enter a valid phone number (digits, spaces and + ( ) / - .).

address.toggle: Add a billing address (e.g. for an invoice to a company)

payment.title: Payment method
payment.noneAvailable: No payment method is available for the tickets in your cart. Please contact the organiser.

PAYPAL.label: PayPal
PAYPAL.description: Pay securely with your PayPal account, card or other methods offered by PayPal. Your tickets are confirmed immediately.

BANK_TRANSFER.label: Bank transfer (prepayment)
BANK_TRANSFER.description: Your seats are reserved for you. You receive the bank details and your personal payment reference right after ordering.

unavailable.TOO_CLOSE_TO_EVENT: Not available any more because the event starts soon.
unavailable.EVENT_DISABLED: Not offered for an event in your cart.

summary.title: Your order
summary.graceNote: Your reservation was extended once by {minutes} minutes for checking out.

terms: I accept the <terms>terms and conditions</terms> and have read the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
submitPayPal: Place binding order and pay with PayPal
submitHintPayPal: You will be forwarded to PayPal to complete the payment.
submitHintBankTransfer: You receive the payment details on the next page and by e-mail.
proofNote: Reduced tickets: please bring your proof of eligibility – it is checked at the entrance.

order.title: Order {number}

paypalNotice.pending: PayPal is still processing your payment. We will confirm your order by e-mail as soon as it is completed.
paypalNotice.cancelled: The PayPal payment was cancelled. Your seats are still reserved – you can try again below.
paypalNotice.failed: The PayPal payment could not be completed. Please try again or choose another funding source at PayPal.
paypalNotice.expired: The payment window of this order has expired and the seats were released. If money was taken, it is refunded automatically.
paypalNotice.unavailable: PayPal is temporarily unavailable. Your seats are reserved – please try again in a moment.
paypalNotice.notavailable: PayPal payment is currently not available. Your seats stay reserved – please try again later.

walletNotice.unavailable: Adding to the wallet did not work just now. Please try again later or use the PDF ticket.

paid.title: Thank you – your payment has been received.
paid.text: Your order is confirmed. Your tickets are sent to {email}.

preparing.title: Your tickets are being created …
preparing.text: This only takes a moment. The page updates automatically.
preparing.timeoutText: Your tickets and invoice are not ready yet. Please reload this page in a few minutes – we will also send them to your e-mail address.

closed.text: The seats have been released. If you still want to attend, please place a new order.

bankTransfer.title: Please transfer the amount
bankTransfer.intro: Your seats are reserved. Please transfer the amount by {date} at the latest, using the payment reference exactly as shown.
bankTransfer.noAccount: You will receive the bank details by e-mail.
bankTransfer.hint: Only the exact payment reference lets us assign your transfer automatically. Unpaid orders are cancelled after the deadline and the seats are released.
bankTransfer.hintNoCancel: Only the exact payment reference lets us assign your transfer automatically.

paypal.title: Complete your payment
paypal.intro: Your seats are reserved until {time}. Complete the payment with PayPal to confirm your order.
paypal.cancelText: Your reserved seats are released immediately and can be bought by others.

order.contact: Questions about your order? Simply reply to the confirmation e-mail sent to {email}.
order.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.

tickets.title: Your tickets
tickets.intro: Show the QR code on your ticket at the entrance – printed, as a PDF on your phone or in your wallet. The code below helps if your ticket has to be looked up manually.

refunded.title: This order has been cancelled and refunded.
refunded.text: The tickets are no longer valid.

partiallyRefunded.title: Some tickets have been cancelled.
partiallyRefunded.text: The cancelled tickets are no longer valid and have been refunded; the remaining tickets stay valid.

adjustment.title: Additional payment required
adjustment.intro: The tariff of the following tickets was changed to a higher-priced one.
adjustment.ticketsStayValid: Your tickets stay valid until the additional payment is settled.
adjustment.confirmHint: After you confirm, you can pay by PayPal or bank transfer.
adjustment.bankHint: Please use exactly this payment reference so that we can assign your transfer.
adjustment.noMethod: No payment method is available online. Please contact us.

paypalNotice.pending: PayPal is still processing your payment. We will confirm it by e-mail as soon as it is completed.
paypalNotice.cancelled: The PayPal payment was cancelled. You can try again below.
paypalNotice.failed: The PayPal payment could not be completed. Please try again.
paypalNotice.expired: This additional payment is no longer open. If money was taken, it is refunded automatically.
paypalNotice.unavailable: PayPal is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
paypalNotice.notavailable: PayPal payment is currently not available. Please try again later.

order.testNotice: This is a test order placed by an administrator on an unpublished event. It is not a real purchase.

account.title: Order faster with a customer account
account.text: Sign in to fill in your details automatically and to find all your orders and tickets in one place. Without an account you can simply continue below as a guest.
